skills.name: sightmap-authoring
skills.description: Use when building or maintaining a sightmap corpus — defining components, authoring .sightmap/ YAML, seeding from a live site or the codebase, running snapshot/coverage/validate/lint, or diagnosing coverage gaps. Activate whenever a .sightmap/ directory is present in the project.
headings: Recommended — global install via npm (no Go toolchain required):
One-off without installing (fine for a single command, not this iterative loop):
Install this skill (and its companion) into ~/.agents/skills at the same time:
persist a capture into the view's set:
or write a one-off snap file (no view set):
skills.description_zh: 构建和维护 sightmap 语料库，定义组件、编写 .sightmap/ YAML，从线上站点或代码库初始化，并执行快照、覆盖率、验证及 lint 检查，诊断覆盖缺口。适用于已有 .sightmap/ 目录的项目。

skills.name: sightmap-browser
skills.description: Use when driving a live browser session with a sightmap — starting or navigating a Chrome session, taking annotated component snapshots to read page state, and interacting with elements by component ID or component query. Activate when a .sightmap/ directory is present and you need to observe or act on the running app.
headings: Component queries (CSS-shaped, over sightmap components + extracted properties)
Console & network — the runtime view of the corpus
skills.description_zh: 通过 sightmap 驱动实时浏览器会话，启动或导航 Chrome，获取带组件注释的快照读取页面状态，并按组件 ID 或查询与元素交互。适用于项目已有 .sightmap/ 且需观察或操作运行中应用的场景。

skills.name: subtext-privacy
skills.description: Privacy rule management — detect PII in sessions and manage element-block, URL, and network privacy rules. Use when you need to propose, create, list, delete, or promote privacy rules for a Fullstory org.
headings: URL and network rules: no preview step
1. Propose — find PII in a session
2. Create — persist the rules you want
skills.description_zh: 检测 Fullstory 会话中的个人身份信息，管理元素屏蔽、URL 和网络隐私规则，支持提出、创建、列举、删除及提升组织隐私规则。

skills.name: subtext-review
skills.description: Review a completed Subtext session and produce a structured summary. Use when you have a session URL and want to understand what happened — verify a flow, walk through a dev / staging / preview session, or summarize a captured session. Optionally emits reproduction steps on request.
headings: Step 2: Form hypotheses from the map
Step 3: Zoom to confirm — as recipes, coarse to fine
Step 6: Reproduction steps — only if asked
skills.description_zh: 审查已完成的 Subtext 会话并生成结构化总结，根据会话网址核验流程、回顾开发／预发布／预览过程或总结录制内容；可按要求提供复现步骤。

skills.name: subtext-session
skills.description: Session replay tools for analyzing Fullstory session recordings. Sparse API catalog — tools are self-describing.
skills.description_zh: 使用会话回放工具分析 Fullstory 录制会话；原说明提供简略 API 目录，各工具通过自身描述说明用法。

skills.name: subtext-setup-plugin
skills.description: Install the Subtext plugin and verify the MCP server is connected. Authenticates via OAuth or API key.
skills.description_zh: 安装 Subtext 插件并验证 MCP 服务连接，支持 OAuth 或 API 密钥认证。

skills.name: subtext-shared
skills.description: Foundation skill for the Subtext plugin. MCP tool conventions and security rules. Read this when any skill lists it in PREREQUISITE.
skills.description_zh: 提供 Subtext 插件的基础 MCP 工具约定和安全规则，作为其他技能在 PREREQUISITE 中声明的前置技能。

skills.name: subtext-sightmap
skills.description: Connect a project's .sightmap/ corpus to Subtext session review — maintain it with the bundled sightmap skills and upload its definitions into review tools so snapshots come back with semantic component names.
headings: run from the project root (where .sightmap/ lives):
skills.description_zh: 将项目的 .sightmap/ 语料库接入 Subtext 会话审查，借助随包 sightmap 技能维护组件定义并上传到审查工具，使快照使用具有语义的组件名称。

skills.name: subtext-telemetry
skills.description: Workflow telemetry logging — record AI-reported workflow milestones (currently the onboarding flow) for funnel analysis. Use when executing an instrumented Subtext workflow and you need to log step-by-step progress events.
skills.description_zh: 记录 AI 报告的工作流里程碑，用于漏斗分析，原说明当前覆盖入驻流程；适用于执行已埋点的 Subtext 工作流并逐步记录进度事件。

skills.name: subtext-using-subtext
skills.description: Overview of the Subtext plugin — when to reach for session review vs privacy tools. Read to orient before reviewing a Fullstory session or managing privacy rules.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Subtext 插件及会话审查、隐私工具的使用选择，适用于审查 Fullstory 会话或管理隐私规则前了解插件范围。
